title: entity.create.proposed payload
description: A proposal to create an entity with its full initial attribute set (contracts.md C-02, api-contracts.md 2.3.4). meta.agent is mandatory when an agent proposes.

proposal_id.description: Optional here, unlike entity.update.proposed: State echoes it in entity.update.rejected reason=duplicate_entity when the publisher sent one.

cause.description: Union of api-contracts.md 2.3.4 and the Causes column of state-and-mechanics.md 4.6: every cause a row of contracts.OwnershipRules allows must be publishable.
